Nora is a resident of Andrews' Cove. She is characterized by her black hair and black eyes.

## History

Nora is one of the imaginary rock friends created by [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), residing along the shore in his fantastical stories. In a composition letter written to his teacher [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) describes Nora alongside other imaginative figures like the [Golden Lady](../character/golden-lady.md) and the [Twin Sailors](../character/twin-sailor.md). She exists as part of Paul's vibrant fantasy world, which he shares with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) before clarifying that the tales are not real.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P1](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0001), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P2](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0002), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P4](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0004), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P6](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0006), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P8](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0008), +22 more_
